If you want, it’s possible to configure node or engine updates for fix too. Best to set that in your algolia preset

________________________________
From: Alex S <notifications@github.com>
Sent: Monday, March 12, 2018 4:33:58 PM
To: algolia/instantsearch.js
Cc: Rhys Arkins; Mention
Subject: Re: [algolia/instantsearch.js] fix(deps): update dependency events to v1.1.1 (#2804)


@bobylito<https://github.com/bobylito> it's part of the "conventional commits" approach, which uses "fix" when a commit should bump a patch version or "chore" when it can stay the same. The default Renovate approach is that changes to dependencies are a "fix" as they could change behaviour and hence should bump minor version or more

I'm not sure of the interpretation of conventional commit from renovate here. For example, this PR is a fix but the update is a patch version. But the node version (8.4.0 to 8.9.4) is a chore #2803<https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2803>
